headline.title: How Turkey Hacked the Hair Transplant Industry
headline.summary: Turkey's hair transplant industry has evolved into a billion-dollar sector through the integration of specialized motors and machine learning algorithms. This continuous innovation has positioned Turkey as a leading destination for hair restoration procedures.

articles.title: SoftBank says it will invest up to €75 billion to build French data centers
articles.summary: SoftBank announced plans to invest up to €75 billion in the development and operation of French data centers, aiming to add up to 5 gigawatts of capacity. This investment is part of the company's strategy to expand its presence in the European data center market.

articles.title: I put Google’s 24/7 AI assistant Gemini Spark to work, and it’s actually pretty useful
articles.summary: Google's Gemini Spark is an AI assistant designed to automate everyday tasks such as summarizing emails and planning local events. However, the rationale behind its development as a separate product remains unclear.

articles.title: ‘What a joke’: Github Copilot’s new token-based billing spurs consternation among devs
articles.summary: GitHub Copilot has introduced a new token-based billing system, leading to dissatisfaction among developers. This change marks a significant shift in the service's pricing structure, raising concerns within the developer community.

articles.title: As the browser wars heat up, here are the hottest alternatives to Chrome and Safari in 2026
articles.summary: The article provides an overview of several alternative web browsers that are emerging as competitors to Chrome and Safari in 2026. It highlights key features and advantages of these browsers, showcasing their potential to reshape the current browser landscape.

articles.title: How one founder’s bet on ‘the old school web’ is paying off
articles.summary: Craig Campbell, a former Meta engineer, has chosen to focus on building a traditional website instead of pursuing opportunities in the AI sector, despite the influx of investment in that area. His decision reflects a growing interest in "the old school web," and he aims to leverage his experience to create a successful online platform.

articles.title: Meta is reportedly developing an AI pendant
articles.summary: Meta is reportedly working on an AI-powered pendant, indicating a significant investment in AI-driven hardware. This development aligns with the company's broader strategy to integrate artificial intelligence into its product offerings.

articles.title: Do You Actually Need to Pay for Transcription Software?
articles.summary: The article evaluates the effectiveness of Wispr Flow and other AI-powered transcription software, comparing their features and performance against free alternatives. It concludes whether a subscription is worthwhile for users seeking transcription services.

articles.title: AI grifters are creating fake Black people to sell Shein junk
articles.summary: The article discusses the emergence of AI-generated personas, specifically fake Black individuals, being used to promote and sell products from Shein on social media platforms like TikTok. It highlights the challenges faced by real creators, such as a Black woman named Aliyah, who struggles to gain visibility and sales amidst this trend.

articles.title: The SpaceX IPO is great for Elon Musk and terrible for you
articles.summary: Elon Musk has filed for a SpaceX IPO, drawing comparisons to the controversial WeWork IPO due to concerns about the company's financial viability and potential risks for investors. Critics argue that the offering could disproportionately benefit Musk and his associates while leaving everyday investors vulnerable.

articles.title: Coders are refusing to work without AI — and that could come back to bite them
articles.summary: Researchers caution that while AI is enabling coders to work more efficiently, it may not enhance the quality of the code produced, potentially leading to future issues. This reliance on AI tools raises concerns about the long-term implications for software development practices.
